author: Zephyr I
title: LN per-gate normalization: ConvLSTM + 1-head Attn (default PG)
abstract: Test LayerNorm applied separately to each gate preactivation in ConvLSTM (vs a single LN over all gates) with single-head attention pooling. Capacity and training fixed.
